Ruth SRE: recommend staged ramps: 15% -> 50% -> 100% with a 20m soak at each stage to let KV and prefix caches fill. Abort if p95 > 380ms or error_rate > 0.7%.
Ibrahim Eng: Ill own the load harness. Using k6 + prometheus. Will upload scripts to git.redwood/internal/loads/sable-warm.
Luca (Sable): Confirmed on our end. Note: internal batch job runs 09:15 PT, avoid that window.
Theo (Ops): ack. windows now 08:30, 09:50, 11:10 PT. Autoscale policy: min=3, max=10, scale_up at >70% gpu util for 60s, scale_down at <45% for 120s.
Maya (CS): billing: create reserve id Q-SABLE-0626 and loop in finance for pre-approval. @finance please confirm.
ProvisionBot: allocation request received: pool_id=rp-8122, nodes=5xA100, window=2h, owner=Sable. Provisioning started.
Ibrahim Eng: load snippet: `k6 run --vus 300 --duration 30m sable_priming.js`. Metrics: p50/p95, tokens/s, GPU util, mem headroom, OOMs. Alert if GPU util >94% for 4m.
Luca (Sable): sending 8k sample prompts and traffic mix CSV now. KMS keys shared: alias sable-prod-kms.
Ruth SRE: fallback plan: if token regressions or OOMs, switch to model-variant stable-1.1 and re-run warm at half concurrency.
Maya (CS): risk callout: failure to meet SLOs will trigger renewal outreach. Post-run retro same day 15:30 PT. Please react with :white_check_mark: when checklist done.
Theo (Ops): final readiness ping 30m prior. Will post runbook link in 1h.
Ibrahim Eng: pushed scripts and README, branch=sable-warm-2026.
Maya (CS): thanks team closing loop: paste results here and attach perf snapshots to account folder. :handshake:
